description: This file provides helper methods for creating self-signed X.509 certificates, including certificate creation, conversion to and from base64 encoding, and includes constants related to TLS certificate usages.

classes.name: TestCertificateHelper
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for creating and handling self-signed certificates for testing purposes.

methods.name: CreateSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Creates a new self-signed X.509 certificate with specified subject name and optional extended key usage OIDs.

methods.name: ConvertToBase64
methods.description: Converts an X509Certificate2 object to a base64-encoded string for storage or transmission.

methods.name: ConvertFromBase64
methods.description: Reconstructs an X509Certificate2 object from a base64-encoded string.
